paragraphs: Free Time in Our Town. This leaflet is for young people who want something new to do after school. It was made by the Explorers club, and Teacher Kim read it first. Leo drew the pictures, and Lily checked the words. It tells you about three free-time activities, and each one has a day, a time, and a price. Which one will you choose?

Cricket Club. Cricket is a game with a bat and a ball, and two teams play it on a big grass field. The club meets on the sports field every Wednesday at half past four. Coach Matt teaches the club. He gives each child a place in a team. The length of each lesson is one hour. A season has ten lessons, and the price is five hundred baht. The club has bats and balls for you, but please bring a hat and a bottle of water.

English Chatroom. The English Chatroom is an online room for school children, where you write messages to other classes. A teacher reads every message, so the room is safe. It opens in the school computer room every Tuesday at four o'clock. Each session has a length of forty minutes, and it is free. There is one important rule for the chatroom. Never tell anybody your password.

Nature Morning. On one Saturday each month, you can discover the nature park with a ranger. Ranger Mark is the speaker for the morning, and he talks about birds, insects, and trees for twenty minutes. Then he takes the group on a walk along the path. The morning starts at nine o'clock and ends at twelve o'clock. The price is one hundred baht, and the money pays for a snack. Parents must sign a note for this morning.

Rules for All Activities. Come ten minutes before the start, and bring your own bottle of water. Listen to the teacher or the ranger, and ask before you take a photo of a person. Every child must have a note from a parent. If you cannot come, tell the teacher before the day.

How to Join. The program for the season is on the board in the school library. Read it, choose an activity, and ask a parent to sign the note. Give the note to Teacher Kim on Thursday, at the club hour. Do you have a question? Write to us in Explorers' Blog, and we will answer you.
